## Key Features & Differentiators:
1. **AI Quick Capture**: Natural language expense logging (e.g., "Paid 250 for petrol via GPay") — categorized in under 3 seconds.
2. **Safe Daily Spending Limit Calculator**: Automatically calculates dynamic safe daily spending allowance so users never run out of money before payday.
3. **AI Bank Statement & Passbook Scanner**: Upload PDF or passbook image to auto-detect and categorize real transaction lines with zero manual entry.
4. **48-Hour Impulse Purchase Blocker**: Enforces a psychological pause before buying non-essentials, helping users save ₹5,000+ every month.
5. **Zen AI Money Coach (Roast Mode & Zen Master Mode)**: 24/7 financial advisor that analyzes spending habits, tracks 50/30/20 budget adherence, and provides actionable wealth-building advice.
6. **Shared Couple & Family Budget Sync**: Real-time multi-device ledger sync for households and partners.
7. **Gamified Wealth Arcade (Coin Catcher)**: Interactive financial discipline game where users dodge high-interest debt traps and compound SIP investments.
8. **100% Privacy & Security**: Native on-device encryption, zero tracking cookies, biometric lock, and no selling of user financial data.
